_comment: Transcribed from in-game screenshots taken 2026-08-04 (Steam capture 20260804154419 (art), 154623-154632 (loadout)). The page leads with the in-game class name, which is the title the loadout screen shows; the model designation rides underneath. One page covers both faction variants; both models were captured, NATO on 2026-08-04 15:43-15:48 and Pax Armata at 16:59-17:00. TBD is deliberate everywhere: a slot screen names every option in its row but describes only the highlighted one, so most options are named and not yet described.
name: Armored Transport
_alias_note: "ATP" is the owner's shorthand for the slot, not a name the game or EA uses, so it is not an alias.

options.name: Emergency Repair
options.description: Repairs damaged vehicles. Can only be activated when the vehicle is in a low-health state.

options.name: Integrated Medbay
options.description: Increases health regeneration of friendly soldiers within a radius of the vehicle. Remains active even after all soldiers have exited the vehicle but remain nearby.

options.name: Grenade Intercept
options.title: Grenade Intercept System
options.description: Tracks and destroys incoming projectiles such as hand-thrown and launched grenades. Can intercept up to three projectiles during a window of activation that begins after the initial detection.

options.name: Combat Awareness
options.description: Hostiles remain spotted for longer when they damage the vehicle or the owner's squadmates while near the vehicle. Remains active even after all soldiers have exited the vehicle but remain nearby.
options.title: Combat Awareness System

options.name: Mobile Command
options.description: Increases the rate of capture when the vehicle is inside an objective's capture area. Remains active even after all soldiers have exited the vehicle but remain nearby.
options.title: Mobile Command Station

options.name: Heavy Machine Gun
options.description: A machine gun ideal for combatting unarmored vehicles and infantry at long range.

options.name: Countermeasures
options.title: Mine Countermeasures
options.description: Detects mines and C-4 explosives enabling the operator to activate countermeasures to destroy them.
